plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the biography of Mark Felt, a senior FBI official in the 1970s, describes President Richard Nixon being shown secret technology. Michels raises it while talking with Steven Greer, a campaigner for UFO disclosure. If true, it would mean a sitting president was let in on hidden technology.
